rows.actualOwner: ShopCrimeRuntime over Shop inventory, retail physical runtime and visitor activity
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryResolve takes an exact retail lot, commits the lot to the external Sink, then publishes FacilityStockConsumedEvent and FacilityCrimeEvent

rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: create a persistent ShopliftingTransaction carrying the exact lot, actor/facility immutable display snapshots, loss and result key; reserve before TryCommitExactRetailExternalSink; commit shop stock, physical Sink and outcome together; acknowledge before legacy events

rows.actualOwner: ShopCustomerInteractionService plus IGameMoneyAccount

rows.missingJointSeam: the money account has no prepared credit transaction or exact compensation token tied to the facility-service operation
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: introduce an idempotent facility-revenue credit plan with operation id, actor/facility snapshots and before/after balance; reserve outcome before credit; persist credit receipt and outcome key in one service-completion outbox; publish event after acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: FacilityShopService/DailyFacilityShopRuntime over IGameMoneyAccount and FacilityShopUnlockState
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryPurchaseOffer spends money and applies the unlock before purchaseCompleted invokes PublishPurchase
rows.missingJointSeam: there is no detached unlock-state candidate and no exact refund/rollback receipt spanning both authorities
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: replace the static callback transaction with a FacilityShopPurchasePlan; prepare exact offer/display/cost facts, stage money debit and cloned unlock state, publish both with a persistent purchase outbox and outcome revision, then emit the event

rows.actualOwner: ShopCrimeRuntime and ShopCustomerInteractionService over retail physical stock
rows.currentMutationPoint: publish occurs after BuildingRetailPurchaseCommitResult or external-Sink commit reports success
rows.saveAuthority: PhysicalItemsSaveSection plus facility retail stock state
rows.missingJointSeam: the event omits exact lot/commit identity in the normal purchase path and neither producer reserves an outcome before physical mutation
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: integrate a higher exact RetailPurchase/Shoplifting result preserving lot id, item definition/instance, category, quantity, facility and consumer; only classify this event as a substitute after that result is atomically ledger-integrated

rows.actualOwner: the facility interaction/session owner; BuildingVisitEventPublisher is only an observer adapter
rows.currentMutationPoint: PublishVisit receives already-selected visitor/facility references and immediately emits the event without a receipt

rows.missingJointSeam: no operation id, terminal outcome, owner revision, exact visit facts, or rollback-capable owner is present at this port
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: move capture to the authoritative facility-use completion command; build a FacilityVisitReceipt with service session id, terminal result, participant snapshots and location; prepare before terminal session mutation and commit via a persistent service outbox

rows.actualOwner: GrandProjectRuntime with GrandProjectApplicationAdapter and physical batch disposition
rows.currentMutationPoint: ApplyWork commits delivered materials pending, writes pendingPhysicalCommit, mutates completed-project state, then acknowledges the physical receipt
rows.missingJointSeam: pendingPhysicalCommit does not contain a gameplay result key/canonical payload and outcome capacity is not reserved before the physical Sink
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: extend GrandProjectPhysicalCommitSaveData with result key, immutable project/item display snapshots and outcome phase; reserve before CommitDeliveredMaterialsPending; commit project candidate plus outcome while physical receipt remains pending; acknowledge last

rows.actualOwner: GuestRequestDeliveryRuntime/V20 campaign state with physical transfer gateway
rows.currentMutationPoint: AdvanceDelivery calls TryCommitTransferPending, then stateCommands.TryRecordGuestRequestDeliveryReceipt records the campaign-side outbox
rows.missingJointSeam: the campaign row lacks gameplay result identity and exact immutable guest, venue and item display snapshots; prepare is after neither mutation
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: extend GuestRequestDeliverySaveData with outcome result key/revision and frozen participant/item snapshots; reserve before physical transfer; commit the campaign receipt and gameplay outcome before physical acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: ItemTransferService over WorldItemRepository and ItemQuantityReservationService
rows.currentMutationPoint: the service relocates or creates the extracted stack, decrements source quantity, retargets lease slices and only then creates ItemExtractionReceipt
rows.missingJointSeam: rollback exists only on internal branch failure; successful extraction returns no reversible handle and no durable pending extraction row
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: split extraction into Prepare/Commit/Acknowledge with a persistent extraction outbox containing exact source and destination stack/component snapshots; reserve outcome from the prepared shape, mutate, write exact receipt, commit at physical repository revision, then acknowledge

rows.actualOwner: MetaProgressionState/MetaProgressionRuntime
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryPurchaseUpgrade increments SpentCurrency and UpgradeLevels before MetaProgressionRuntime publishes the event
rows.missingJointSeam: state exposes no purchase preview, detached candidate replacement, rollback snapshot, operation sequence or persistent outcome outbox
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: add a monotonic purchase sequence and MetaUpgradePurchasePlan with definition reference, title/pronunciation snapshot, cost and level transition; prepare first, replace a cloned aggregate plus outbox at the new revision, commit outcome, then publish legacy UI/event

rows.actualOwner: PackagedLotTareDispositionService over IPackagedLotTareOutputGateway
rows.currentMutationPoint: EnsureTerminalSinkOutputs iterates planned tare outputs and spawns each missing output before constructing the aggregate receipt
rows.missingJointSeam: the gateway supports SpawnOutput but not exact rollback/removal; a later failure can leave earlier outputs and no outcome row
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: use an exact-source batch publication transaction with Prepare/Rollback/Acknowledge for every tare output, persist parent/output commit ids and result key, reserve outcome before the first spawn and remove the physical pending row only after outcome acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: PhysicalItemExactSourcePublicationService over planned-output admission and publication gateways
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryCommit admits the prepared batch, acknowledges/release-publishes it, retires authority and removes the in-memory Pending before returning the receipt
rows.saveAuthority: PhysicalItemsSaveSection plus each domain save owner that recreates exact-source restore descriptors
rows.missingJointSeam: the pending exact-source transaction carries no gameplay result key or delivery phase and is removed before an outcome can be canonically acknowledged
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: persist the exact-source transaction/result key with its domain restore descriptor; reserve during TryPrepare; commit the physical admission and outcome while pending remains; acknowledge publication and clear the transaction only after ledger acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: PhysicalItemSourcePublicationService over IEquipmentPhysicalItemGateway
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryEnsureLooseOutputs spawns every missing deterministic commit-marked stack in sequence and returns only after postcondition checks
rows.saveAuthority: PhysicalItemsSaveSection plus the abstract source owner
rows.missingJointSeam: commit-marker idempotency prevents duplicate minting but cannot undo a partial batch or prove a gameplay-outcome commit; no pending source-publication outbox exists
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: route through PhysicalItemExactSourcePublicationService or add a prepared batch transaction with exact rollback; persist definition/instance refs, quantities, masses and display snapshots with the result key; commit source owner, physical batch and outcome before acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: PhysicalItemTransformService/WorldItemRepository
rows.currentMutationPoint: the service spawns all outputs, consumes source stacks, refreshes markers and then constructs the transform receipt
rows.missingJointSeam: quantitiesBefore/source mutation snapshots are local and discarded after success; there is no durable transform outbox or post-success rollback handle
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: introduce a PhysicalItemTransformPlan and persistent pending transform row with exact input/output definition and instance refs; reserve outcome before spawn, write exact receipt after mutation, rollback on commit failure and clear only after acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: RegionalSupplyContractRuntime/RegionalSupplyContractDeliveryOutbox with physical transfer and money credit adapters
rows.currentMutationPoint: AdvanceDelivery commits physical transfer, records delivery fields on the contract, publishes reward/status and then acknowledges the transfer
rows.saveAuthority: Regional supply contract state in its planning save section plus PhysicalItemsSaveSection and TreasuryEconomySaveSection
rows.missingJointSeam: the existing phase enum covers physical and reward states only; it has no outcome key/revision, display snapshots, or delivery acknowledgement state
rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: add OutcomePrepared/OutcomeCommitted phases and frozen contract/region/item display snapshots; reserve before TryCommitDeliveryTransferPending; commit contract candidate and outcome before reward/physical acknowledgements

rows.actualOwner: ItemTransferService reserved retail transfer over world stacks, carried inventory, leases and unique-item binding
rows.currentMutationPoint: the service removes carried entries, consumes lease slices and source records, binds unique lots, then returns an in-process rollback receipt
rows.saveAuthority: PhysicalItemsSaveSection plus character carried-inventory save owner and retail unique-instance authority

rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: persist a retail transfer transaction row with exact lots, carry/source undo data, result key and owner revisions; reserve outcome first, commit all three authorities plus ledger, then release the rollback row after acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: ResourceStockPolicyRuntime/ResourceStockPolicySaleOutbox with physical transfer and IIdempotentGameMoneyAccount
rows.currentMutationPoint: EvaluateSale commits physical transfer pending, records ResourceStockPolicyPendingSale, credits income and acknowledges the transfer during finalization

rows.missingJointSeam: ResourceStockPolicyPendingSale stores physical/income phases but not gameplay-outcome capacity, result identity or immutable item display metadata

rows.actualOwner: StockSupplyService for paid deliveries and OffenseStockRewardGrantHandler for reward spawns

rows.actualOwner: WarehouseMassAdmissionService plus external warehouse inventory mutation owner

rows.recommendedMinimumSeam: move warehouse inventory insertion behind a mass-admission transaction that owns both candidate states; reserve outcome after receipt calculation but before insertion, publish inventory/admission/outcome at one revision and retain a save-backed pending row until acknowledgement

rows.actualOwner: WorldResourceRuntime with WorldResourceEnvironmentPortAdapter and physical output publication
rows.currentMutationPoint: TryDebitSource debits the renewable patch; a later output publication failure invokes TryRollbackRenewablePatchDebit, while successful cycle completion persists resource/output state

rows.actualOwner: AbilityShopping plus ItemTransferService reserved retail transaction

rows.actualOwner: FacilityShopService over IGameMoneyAccount and FacilityShopUnlockState

rows.missingJointSeam: no detached unlock candidate, reversible debit receipt, monotonic operation identity or save-backed result/outcome row
